decisionsTitle: «Tema v1» and «Tema v2» instead of «Aspectul nou», the calendar's selectors in the family of its other controls, and the calendar's head under Tema v2
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13:** «Mai e o chestie de design legat de aspectul nou (care ar trebui să se numească „temă” btw, și să avem tema v1 și tema v2), primele 2 selectoare arată diferit».

**Decision (amending §708, §720, §734).**

1. **The name.** The setting the club read as «Aspectul nou» is now «Tema», one choice of two in «Setări» → «Aspect»: **«Tema v1»** (EN "Theme v1"), the site as it has been, and **«Tema v2»** ("Theme v2"), the facelift. It is the same two-radio form as before — the same field `look`, the same stored value (`off` | `on`), the same `data-look="2026"` scope, no migration, no change to `src/theme/look.ts`'s selectors — with new words everywhere the club or a visitor reads them: the card's title and legend («Alege tema»), the save button («Salvează tema»), the confirmation, the saved alert, the design page's «Mostre» and its comparison, the cover photo's help, and `docs/REDESIGN.md` and `docs/VIBECODING.md` (which say once that Tema v2 was «Aspectul nou» until 2026-10-13). The old names in `DECISIONS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `SPECS.md` stay as they were written; identifiers and code comments keep the old name. «Temă» had a second meaning on the same «Aspect» page — light against dark — and it is now «varianta deschisă» / «varianta întunecată» (EN light / dark mode) in «Mărimea textului», «Nuanța fundalului», «Culoarea de accent», the confirmations and the design page's two schemes, in both catalogues, so «ambele teme» no longer exists and «Tema» means only Tema v1 or Tema v2 (a unit test reads every `Admin` string for it). The public toggle's «Temă întunecată» / «Temă luminoasă» (`Site.themeDark`, `Site.themeLight`) stays: a visitor never sees «Tema v1» or «Tema v2», so for them «temă» has the one meaning.

2. **The calendar's two selectors under Tema v2.** «Luna» and «Anul» were outlined MUI selects with floating legends beside the soft segmented «Lună | An» / «Calendar | Listă» and «Azi». Under the look only (`UNDER_LOOK`, in `CalendarPicker.tsx`) they are now of one family with them: the same 44-pixel height (from `sm` too, where they were 34), the same 12-pixel radius ("Azi" moved from 10 to 12), the `divider` border on the paper surface, `primary.main` on hover and a 2-pixel `primary.main` border on focus (the only focus indicator a native select has; mouse and touch focus show it too), the caret in the text's colour, and no floating legend — the label stays the select's accessible name, visually hidden, and the notch it cut in the outline is gone. Still the same island and `router.push`, so it works as before; at 320 pixels the period row is one 44-pixel row and the first week stays above the fold (§569). No colour literal: `background.paper`, `divider`, `primary.main` and `text.primary` only. With Tema v1 the head is drawn exactly as before.

3. **The head of the calendar under Tema v2** (2026-10-13; amending §292, §413, §487 and §569). The owner: «textul… „Calendar” ar trebui să dispară pentru că e redundant și tooltipul cu semnul întrebării să vină în partea de jos chiar sub opțiunile de calendar»; «evenimentele deja trecute ar trebui să fie un pic blurred, ca să semene cu Google Calendar»; «filtrele pot apărea aici inline ca să mai putem economisi spațiu»; «textul ăsta de „calendar” e redundant acum». Under Tema v2 only — the page reads the setting itself, as it already did for the next event, so Tema v1 is drawn exactly as before:

   a. **No visible «Calendar».** The page keeps its one `h1` «Calendar», visually hidden (the house's clipped style, as the home page's is without its hero), and draws neither the eyebrow nor the sentence. The wordmark stays, blue as ever and above the `h1`; the «CALENDAR» band under it was that eyebrow, so it goes with it — there is one `h1` in the document and the wordmark was never it (§292).

   b. **The «?» under the controls.** The fold (§487; its panel carries the sentence, the two doors and the feed's address, §674) stands in `calendar-help-row`, a row of its own under the controls and before the month, at its end, 44 px, the panel hanging from the row over the month; scripts off as before (a native `<details>`). From `sm` too, where it had no desktop form under the look. At 320 px the row takes the place of the head's row it replaces, so the first week stays above the fold (§569). Off the look the fold is where it was, in the head, on a phone only; the page draws it once, never both.

   c. **«Filtre» on the chips' line.** The summary is the line's last item, outside `ScrollRow`, so on a phone it stays in sight while the chips scroll; the chips take the rest of the line. The slot (`CalendarFilterSlot`) and the panel's box are `display: contents` under the look, so the `<details>` is the line's own flex item (`visibility` is inherited, so a held slot keeps its place and the controls still do not move, §575) and the panel — the form — hangs from the line's bottom edge, full width, over the month, as the «?»'s does; the ticked-filters row wraps to a line of its own. Scripts off as before (§413). The listing's «Filtre» is untouched (phase 5). Off the look: the chips are not drawn and «Filtre» is the block it was.

   d. **Past dates faded.** A date on a day before the page's own day in the club's zone is drawn like Google Calendar draws one: the lighter fill (`action.hover`) and the softer words (`text.secondary`) in place of its kind's colours, light and dark, from the theme's tokens, never a colour literal and **never a blur** (a blur is unreadable and the owner's «blurred» meant Google's look); the words stay at least 3 : 1 on the fill (AA for large text, unit-tested for both schemes), the dot is dimmed, the entry is still the link it was (grid and list share the entry). It is decided on the server by the day (`onPastDay`): the period pages are static for the day, held to Brașov's midnight (§549, §574), so an hour is not a rule they could keep, and **an event earlier today is not past** — it fades from tomorrow's page. Under Tema v2 a visually-hidden «a trecut» / "past" follows the entry's sentence for a screen reader (`Events.calendar.past`); under Tema v1 nothing is marked.

**Refused:** swapping the select's caret glyph for a chevron (it would change Tema v1's pixels, and the two controls share one component); a new select component (the existing one is styled under the look); renaming the stored value or the `data-look` scope (a migration and a flip for nothing the visitor sees). A past rule by the hour (stale within the hour on a static page); `opacity` or `filter: blur` for the fade (the words fall below AA, and the owner's model is Google Calendar's flat fade); a second «?» in the head under the look (two ids, and the two places contradicting the owner's «chiar sub opțiunile»); moving «Filtre» into `ScrollRow` (it would scroll away on a phone); in-flow panel under the chips line (it would push the month down 44 px a press).
changelogLine: - **«Tema v1» and «Tema v2»** — the setting «Aspectul nou» is now the choice «Tema» (Tema v1: the site as it has been; Tema v2: the facelift), light and dark are «varianta deschisă» / «varianta întunecată» beside it; and under Tema v2 the calendar's «Luna» and «Anul» selectors are drawn like the segmented controls and «Azi» beside them, the visible «Calendar» title and the wordmark's band are gone (one hidden `h1`), the «?» stands under the controls, «Filtre» sits at the end of the chips' line, and dates on days gone are faded like Google Calendar's. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The setting that switches the facelift is drawn as the choice «Tema» with two radios, «Tema v1» and «Tema v2» ("Theme v1", "Theme v2"), the same field and stored value as before, and neither catalogue reads «Aspectul nou» or "the new look"; on the «Aspect» page light and dark are «varianta deschisă» / «varianta întunecată» ("light mode" / "dark mode") and no `Admin` string says «ambele teme», «tema deschisă» or «tema întunecată» (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the calendar with «Tema v2» on, at 1280 and at 320 pixels the «Luna» and «Anul» selectors are as high as the segmented group beside them (at least 44 pixels), have its radius, show no floating label while «Luna» and «Anul» stay their accessible names, and at 320 pixels the period row stays one row; with «Tema v1» the head is today's, its labels drawn (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the calendar with «Tema v2» on, at 1280 and at 320 pixels no «Calendar» title is drawn above the chips' line, the page has exactly one `h1`, «Calendar», visually hidden, and the kit-face wordmark is drawn with no band under it; with «Tema v1» the title and the intro sentence are drawn as before (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the calendar with «Tema v2» on, the «?» is a 44-pixel native fold at the end of a row under the calendar's controls and before the month, at 1280 and at 320 pixels, its panel opens from there with the two calendar links and the feed's address, with scripts off too, and the first week's row ends inside a 320 × 568 screen; with «Tema v1» the fold is in the page's head on a phone only (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the calendar with «Tema v2» on, «Filtre» is the last item of the kind chips' line, outside the sideways scroller and at least 44 pixels tall, so on a phone it stays in sight while the chips scroll; its panel opens below the whole line at the line's full width and its form submits with scripts off; the line is one row at 320 pixels; with «Tema v1» the chips are not drawn and «Filtre» is on a line of its own (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the calendar with «Tema v2» on, a date on a day before the page's day in the club's time zone is marked past on the server, drawn with the lighter fill and softer words from the theme's tokens (never a colour literal, never a blur, at least 3 : 1 in both schemes), still a link, in the grid and in the list, and read out with «a trecut» / "past"; an event earlier today is not past; with «Tema v1» no date is marked (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: Tema v1 / Tema v2; the calendar's selectors match; the calendar's head under Tema v2
